te: Figure skater Alina Gorbacheva won the Challenger in Budapest
de: Bronze medalist of the championship of Russia-2025 skater Alina Gorbacheva won her first start in the international arena at the adult level - the Challenger tournament in Budapest.

te: A resident of Finland has installed a 20-meter tower to watch Russia
de: A resident of Finland installed a 20-meter tower on his plot near the border to observe Russia, where he worked for many years. This is reported by the Finnish broadcaster Yle.

te: In Paris during the riots robbed and stripped an elderly couple
de: An elderly couple was robbed during riots in Paris, leaving the 80-year-old couple in their underwear on the street. This is reported by RIA Novosti with reference to the magazine Entrevue.
